/-- An arena entry (MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3; F1): `storage` is the place of the administered storage;
`internal` is the authority that administers it, named by `newArena` (F1); `available` and
`issued` are the logical state of §6, `issued` mapping each issued region to the issued block.
The arena value is not a field: it is the place that holds `internal` (F1), which follows
transfers (A4). The anchor of §6 is not a field either: dependents anchor on the blocks (A10). -/
structure Arena where
  storage : Nat
  internal : Nat
  available : List Nat
  issued : List (List Nat × Nat)
deriving DecidableEq

/-- State `S3 = (F, P, I, A, D)` (MM-03.3 §1), without component `M` (pass-1 arbitrage 1).
`nF` is the next frame identity, so that an exited frame is never reused. `D q` lists the
anchors of place `q`, each an authority identity (pass-1 arbitrage 2). `dead q`: the place is
logically dead (A6, `endUse` and `free`); `freed q`: its storage was released by `free` (A6);
`pin l`: leaf `l` is dynamically pinned (A8). `arenas`: the arena entries registered by
`newArena` (D3). `callParams f`: the parameters given to frame `f` by `enterFrame`, a ghost record
(F6): set by `enterFrame`, never modified, read by no operation. -/
structure S3 where
  F : Frames
  nF : Nat
  P : List Place
  I : Nat → InitSt
  A : List Authority
  D : Nat → List Nat
  dead : Nat → Bool
  freed : Nat → Bool
  pin : Nat → Bool
  arenas : List Arena
  callParams : Nat → List Nat

/-- Contracts `K` (MM-03.3.8) for an execution. Types are a representation choice: regions as
lists of leaves; `SharedMutable`, `Pinned` and `ExternalDone` on leaves; `Deallocable p` and
`FreeCompat p auth` for `free` (A6); `Satisfiable provider shape s` for `alloc` (B5; C9: it
depends on the current state `s`, with the shape encoded as the locals of `enterFrame`, C6).
`Invalidates` is removed (B9). The obligations of each contract are named hypotheses of theorems, never
fields. -/
structure K where
  DeclaredDisjoint : List Nat → List Nat → Prop
  SharedMutable : Nat → Prop
  Pinned : Nat → Prop
  ExternalDone : Nat → Prop
  Deallocable : Nat → Prop
  FreeCompat : Nat → Nat → Prop
  Satisfiable : Nat → List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) → S3 → Prop

/-- Obligation of `DeclaredDisjoint` (MM-03.3.8): a declaration never covers two regions that
really overlap. -/
def DDSound (k : K) : Prop := ∀ r r', k.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → ∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r'

/-- `origin` link of the authority with index `i` (MM-03.3.4). -/
def TransferPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Usable src ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
  s.Usable dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
  HasRight s .modify src ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧
  (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ depsOf s src, s.Active x) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src,
    NoEscape (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe dst)) ∧
  (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D q,
      (AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor x) ∨ q = dst ∨ OwnedWithin s src q) →
      EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) ∧
  AnchorOrderHeld (transferEff s src dst) ∧ SameShape s.P src dst

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (TransferPre k s src dst) := by
  unfold TransferPre; infer_instance

/-- The preconditions of `transfer` other than the shape of the destination (J1): `TransferPre`
without its last clause (`transferPre_iff`). Used to show that a transfer is rejected by the shape
clause alone. -/
def TransferPreBase (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Usable src ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
  s.Usable dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
  HasRight s .modify src ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧
  (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ depsOf s src, s.Active x) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src,
    NoEscape (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe dst)) ∧
  (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D q,
      (AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor x) ∨ q = dst ∨ OwnedWithin s src q) →
      EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) ∧
  AnchorOrderHeld (transferEff s src dst)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (TransferPreBase k s src dst) := by
  unfold TransferPreBase; infer_instance

theorem transferPre_iff {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} :
    TransferPre k s src dst ↔ TransferPreBase k s src dst ∧ SameShape s.P src dst := by
  unfold TransferPre TransferPreBase; simp only [and_assoc]

/-- `transfer` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O4). -/
def TransferStep (k : K) (src dst : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (TransferPre k s src dst) (transferEff s src dst)

/-! ## O5 `depend` (MM-03.3 §3) -/

/-- Effect of `depend(result, anchor)` (MM-03.3 §3, O5): the anchor joins the dependencies of
the result place; existing dependencies are kept; propagation to containing values is computed
by `depsOf`. -/
def dependEff (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with D := fun r => if r = q then s.D q ++ [x] else s.D r }
def StorePre (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top) False ∧
  s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
  (∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q) ∧
  EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p) ∧ isLeaf s.P p ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p)
    True) ∧
  HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p)

instance (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePre s a p) := by unfold StorePre; infer_instance

/-- `store` as a relation (F4). -/
def StoreStep (a p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (StorePre s a p) (storeEff s a p)

/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, A5) -/

/-- Owner of the local of index `i` of `ls` (parent, owning local, kind) in the new frame `f`:
the owning local if any, the new frame otherwise (A5). -/
def localOwner (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (f i : Nat) : Holder :=
  match (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
  | some o => .place o

/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` before G1 and G4 (MM-03.3 §4, O6): the calling frame is active
(non-empty stack); each parameter is an active derived authority (`origin ≠ none`) held by the
caller (A3, read since pass 2 without requiring the caller to be the deriving frame); the parent
and the owner of a local are earlier locals; a part has the owner of its parent. -/
def EnterPreBase (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  s.F ≠ [] ∧
  (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top ∧
    y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
  ∀ i ∈ List.range ls.length,
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)) (fun r => s.P.length ≤ r ∧ r < s.P.length + i ∧
      (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = (ls[r - s.P.length]?).bind (·.2.1)) True ∧
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1)) (fun o => s.P.length ≤ o ∧ o < s.P.length + i) True

instance (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
    Decidable (EnterPreBase s ps ls) := by
  unfold EnterPreBase; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O6): those of `EnterPreBase`; G1: in
`enterEff s ps ls`, the state where the new frame has received its parameters, the direct origin of
every `Modify` parameter is exercisable at no mode (`ParamOriginHidden`); G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in
the arrival state. -/
def EnterPre (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  EnterPreBase s ps ls ∧ (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden (enterEff s ps ls) p) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeld (enterEff s ps ls)

instance (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
    Decidable (EnterPre s ps ls) := by
  unfold EnterPre; infer_instance

/-- `enterFrame` as a relation (MM-03.3 §4, O6; A3). -/
def EnterStep (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (s : S3) :
    Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (EnterPre s ps ls) (enterEff s ps ls)

/-! ## O7 `exitFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, A4, A5, A7) -/

/-- Authority `x` survives the exit to stack `F₀`: active, and held by a holder still live once
the frame is popped, through transitive ownership (A4, A5). A7 speaks of an authority held by
a surviving frame; an authority held by a place is read as held by the frame that ends its
owner chain. -/

| some v => footprint s.P v
  | none => []

/-- Arena invariant (MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3; F1; F2). Clauses of §6: issued regions within the
administered storage (the footprint of `internal`); two simultaneously valid issued regions
disjoint; available regions disjoint from the still distributed ones; added: available regions
within the storage. Clause of A10: each emission is a `Modify` authority derived from `internal`
on its region. F2: the storage is a place of `P`, owned by anything (a local, a static, an
allocated root, a block): the ownership clause of A10 is removed. F1: `internal` is a `Modify`
authority held by a place, the arena value, and covers exactly the footprint of the storage. -/
def ArenaInv (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : Prop :=
  (∀ l ∈ ar.available, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
  ar.issued.Pairwise (fun e e' => s.Active e.2 → s.Active e'.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ e'.1) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ ar.available) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, ∃ y, s.A[e.2]? = some y ∧ y.origin = some ar.internal ∧
    y.footprint = e.1 ∧ y.mode = .modify) ∧
  ar.storage < s.P.length ∧
  (∃ (y : Authority) (v : Nat), s.A[ar.internal]? = some y ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧
    y.holder = .place v) ∧
  (∀ l, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P ar.storage)

/-- Right to update the metadata of the arena (A10; C6, aligned with `ProviderRight`): exercisable
`Modify` on the arena value, or an authority `via` exercisable at `Observe` (B2) with a present
effective mode on every metadata leaf, all `SharedMutable` (a `writeShared`, A9), with valid
dependencies. -/
def MetaRight (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (arenaValue s ar) (fun v => HasRight s .modify v) False ∨
  (s.ExercisableAt via .observe ∧ arenaValue s ar ≠ none ∧
    ∀ l ∈ metaLeaves s ar, effective s via l ≠ none ∧ k.SharedMutable l ∧ DepsValid s l)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) :
    Decidable (MetaRight k s ar via) := by
  unfold MetaRight; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `arena.issue(region)` (MM-03.3 §6; A10; J1): a `Modify` block derived from `internal`
on the region, held by the destination leaf; that leaf, and it only, becomes `Init` (J1, second
bullet), so the initialisation of the arena value is unchanged unless the destination is one of its
leaves (`issue_into_arena_value`; J1, third bullet: a question of the pass-8 report); the region
leaves `available` and joins `issued`. -/
def issueEff (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : S3 × Arena :=
  ({ s.addAuth ⟨.modify, some ar.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩ with
      I := fun l => if l = dst then .init else s.I l },
   { ar with
      available := ar.available.filter fun l => decide (l ∉ region)
      issued := (region, s.A.length) :: ar.issued })

/-- Static preconditions of `arena.issue(region)` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): metadata right (A10); the
region lies in the storage administered by `internal`; the destination `dst` of the block is
usable, exercisable in `Modify` (A2) and holds no initialised value; J1: `dst` is a leaf
(`isLeaf`) that holds no active authority. -/
def IssueStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Prop :=
  MetaRight k s ar via ∧ s.Active ar.internal ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
  s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧
  isLeaf s.P dst ∧
  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst)
    True

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat)
    (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (IssueStatic k s ar via region dst) := by
  unfold IssueStatic; infer_instance

/-- The region is available (MM-03.3 §6): otherwise `issue` fails (A10). -/
def Avail (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Prop := ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ ar.available

instance (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (Avail ar region) := by
  unfold Avail; infer_instance

/-- The abstraction has, through `internal`, effective `Modify` on the region (MM-03.3 §6:
the abstraction has the authority needed to distribute the region). The
disjointness from active emissions is removed (A11): it follows from this right
(`issue_disjoint_redundant`). -/
def IssueRight (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ l ∈ region, effective s ar.internal l = some .modify

instance (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (IssueRight s ar region) := by
  unfold IssueRight; infer_instance

/-- Outcomes of `issue` (A10): `ok`, defined failure `fail` with the state unchanged, `reject`
(pass-1 arbitrage 6). -/
inductive IOutcome where
  | ok (s : S3) (ar : Arena)
  | fail (s : S3) (ar : Arena)
  | reject

/-- `arena.issue` as a relation (MM-03.3 §6; A10): `reject` when a static precondition fails;
`fail`, with the state unchanged, when the region is unavailable; `reject` when the region is
available but `internal` lacks the right to distribute it; G4: `reject` when the arrival state,
where the block is held by `dst`, breaks `AnchorOrderHeld`; `ok` otherwise. A failed `issue`
creates no holding relation and has no arrival state, so G4 is not checked before `fail`. -/
inductive IssueStep (k : K) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (s : S3) :
    IOutcome → Prop where
  | ok : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → IssueRight s ar region →
      AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s
        (.ok (issueEff s ar region dst).1 (issueEff s ar region dst).2)
  | fail : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → ¬ Avail ar region →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.fail s ar)
  | reject : ¬ IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject
  | noRight : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → ¬ IssueRight s ar region →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject
  | noAnchor : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → IssueRight s ar region →
      ¬ AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 → IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject

/-- Determinism of `issue` (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
theorem issue_det {k : K} {ar : Arena} {via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} {s : S3}
    {o₁ o₂ : IOutcome} (h₁ : IssueStep k ar via region dst s o₁)
    (h₂ : IssueStep k ar via region dst s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction

/-- `ok` outcome of `arena.issue` (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
theorem issue_ok_iff {k : K} {ar ar' : Arena} {via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} {s s' : S3} :
    IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.ok s' ar') ↔ IssueStatic k s ar via region dst ∧
      Avail ar region ∧ IssueRight s ar region ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 ∧
      (s', ar') = issueEff s ar region dst := by
  constructor
  · intro h; cases h with
    | ok h1 h2 h3 h4 => exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, e⟩
    have e1 := congrArg Prod.fst e; have e2 := congrArg Prod.snd e
    simp only at e1 e2; subst e1 e2; exact .ok h1 h2 h3 h4

/-- Preconditions of `arena.reset()` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): metadata right; no active authority
derived from `internal`; no usable place anchored on `internal` or on an authority derived from
it. -/
def ResetPre (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) : Prop :=
  MetaRight k s ar via ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ar.internal ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, x ≠ ar.internal ∧ ar.internal ∉ s.ancs x)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) :
    Decidable (ResetPre k s ar via) := by
  unfold ResetPre; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `arena.reset()` (MM-03.3 §6; A10; J1): the whole storage becomes available, the past
emissions are forgotten; the initialisation of the arena value is unchanged (J1). -/
def resetEff (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : S3 × Arena :=
  (s, { ar with available := s.afp ar.internal, issued := [] })

/-- `arena.reset` as a relation (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
def ResetStep (k : K) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 (S3 × Arena) → Prop :=
  Guarded (ResetPre k s ar via) (resetEff s ar)

theorem afp_addAuth_lt {s : S3} {y₀ : Authority} {j : Nat} (h : j < s.A.length) :
    (s.addAuth y₀).afp j = s.afp j := by simp only [S3.afp, addAuth_lt h]

theorem active_addAuth_iff {s : S3} {y₀ : Authority} {x : Nat} (hx : x < s.A.length) :
    (s.addAuth y₀).Active x ↔ s.Active x := by
  simp only [S3.Active, addAuth_lt hx]

/-- The disjointness of a new emission from the active ones follows from the authority of
`internal` (MM-03.3 §6; A11): an active block derived from `internal` covering a leaf takes the
effective `Modify` of `internal` away from it. -/
theorem issue_disjoint_redundant {s : S3} {ar : Arena} {region : List Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (hai : ArenaInv s ar) (hm : ∀ l ∈ region, effective s ar.internal l = some .modify) :
    ∀ e ∈ ar.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ region, l ∉ e.1 := by
  intro e he ha l hl hle
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ho, hf, hmd⟩ := hai.2.2.2.2.1 e he
  obtain ⟨y', hy', ya⟩ := ha; rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'
  have hlt := hwf.origin e.2 y ar.internal hy ho

/-- The state with the entry `i` of `arenas` replaced by `ar` (D3). -/
def arenaSet (s : S3) (i : Nat) (ar : Arena) : S3 := { s with arenas := s.arenas.set i ar }

/-- J1: the leaves of the holder `h`, if it is a place, are all `Init`. -/
def LeavesInit (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .place v => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P v, s.I l = .init
  | .frame _ => True

instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (LeavesInit s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold LeavesInit <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `newArena storage internal` (D3, F1, F2, J1), in order. Kept from D3: exercisable
`Modify` on `storage`; `storage` usable. F1: `internal`, named by the caller, is active, `Modify`,
exercisable at `Modify` (B2), and held by a place, the arena value; the footprint of `internal` is
the footprint of `storage`; no live arena already has `internal` as `internal`. F1 removes the
guard by place index of D3 and the kind of `internal`; F2 removes the ownership of the storage
(A10): the storage may be a local, a static, an allocated root or a block. J1: the leaves of the
arena value, the holder of `internal`, are all `Init` (`LeavesInit`). -/
def NewArenaPre (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Prop :=
  HasRight s .modify storage ∧ s.Usable storage ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧ y.holder.isPlace = true)
      False ∧

      IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.fail s' ar') → IssueAt k i via region dst s (.fail s)

/-- Static storage (D1): each element is a local of `enterFrame` (parent, owning element, kind;

/-!
# Measure of the `NoLock` options (jalon 3, step 4)

The options of the jalon-3 material (`ERN_Jalon3_materiel.md` v2, §5), measured on the kernel as it
is (option 1, no rule), without modifying it:

* option 2, a local rule: an operation does not place an authority into a place it covers
  (`SelfLock`); `store` already rejects it (O8.3), so the rule is measured on `transfer` and
  `issue` (`opt2`);
* option 3, `NoLock`: no self-lock, as a separate clause, and the relation "`b` blocks `a`"
  (`Blocks`) acyclic, checked on the arrival state of `transfer`, `issue` and `store` (`opt3`).

For each case of the list "doit être accepté" of §5 (H11, H19, H29b, H35 to H37, H44 to H47, W1
to W3) and for H49 to H51, `decisions` gives the decision of an option on each `transfer`, `issue`
and `store` of the run of the case (`Ern.MM03.Horrors`), decided on the state where the step runs;
`true` is acceptance. The cost, measured as the brief asks (from the authorities and places the
operation touches, or the whole state): option 2 on `transfer` depends on the state only through the
places and the authorities the transfer moves (`opt2_transfer_local`), on `issue` only through the
region and the destination (`opt2_issue_local`); option 3 depends on authorities the operation does
not touch (`opt3_not_local`). Whether option 3 needs more than the function where the operation runs
(material §5, "locale à une fonction") is not settled here (report, (g)). No option is adopted (task
of jalon 3, step 4: the decision is left to arbitration).
-/

/-- The leaves of a holder (MM-03.3.4): those of a place, none for a frame. -/
def holderLeaves (s : S3) : Holder → List Nat
  | .place p => footprint s.P p
  | .frame _ => []

/-- Self-lock of the authority `a` (material §5, options 2 and 3): `a` is active and held by a place
one of whose leaves it covers. -/
def SelfLock (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder) False

instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (SelfLock s a) := by unfold SelfLock; infer_instance

/-- Option 2 on `transfer src dst` (material §5): no authority moved by the transfer, one held within
the source, is self-locked in the arrival state. -/
def Opt2Transfer (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => heldIn s.P src y.holder) False →
    ¬ SelfLock (transferEff s src dst) j

instance (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (Opt2Transfer s src dst) := by
  unfold Opt2Transfer; infer_instance

self-locked in the arrival state. -/
def Opt2Issue (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  ¬ SelfLock (issueEff s ar region dst).1 s.A.length

instance (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (Opt2Issue s ar region dst) := by

import Ern.MM03

/-!
# Handle pool (jalon 3, step 1)

A library instance of the access discipline, like the arena (MM-03.3 §6): the handle pool of the
jalon-3 material (`ERN_Jalon3_materiel.md` v2, §4). A handle is data and carries no authority. A
resolution is a compound borrow made of kernel operations of `Ern.MM03`, which this module does
not modify: a companion derived from `internal` on the whole storage, then one entry authority per
resolved handle, derived from the companion (`derive` for `resolve`, `split` for `resolveMany`).
`unresolve` is a sequence of `release`, `freeSlot` an `endUse` of the entry content, `allocSlot` a
`write3` of the handle into its destination. The pool entries live beside the kernel state, like
the arena entries of MM-03.3.8 but outside `S3`, so the kernel is unchanged.

`PReach` extends `Reachable` (MM-03.3 §10) with the pool operations; every pool step is a chain of
kernel steps (`pReach_reachable`). Representation choices that the material does not fix are listed
in the jalon-3 report, (f).
-/

namespace Ern.HandlePool

open Ern.MM03

/-! ## State (material §4) -/

/-- Entry of a pool (material §4: `{place, gen : Nat, live : Bool}`): `place` is a part of the
pool storage. -/
structure Slot where
  place : Nat
  gen : Nat
  live : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Pool entry (material §4: `{id, storage, internal, slots}`), abstract like the arena entry of
MM-03.3.8. The pool value is not a field: it is the place that holds `internal` (material §4,
"même règle que F1"). -/
structure Pool where
  id : Nat
  storage : Nat
  internal : Nat
  slots : List Slot
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Handle (material §4: `(id, slot, gen)`): data of fixed size, no authority. -/
structure Handle where
  id : Nat
  slot : Nat
  gen : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Ghost record of a resolution (material §4, compound borrow): identity and `internal` of the
pool, the companion, the mode, and the entry authorities, each tagged with its slot and the
resolved generation ("étiquetée de la génération résolue"). Read by no operation except
`unresolve`, which looks up the entries of a companion. -/
structure Res where
  pool : Nat
  internal : Nat
  comp : Nat
  mode : Mode
  entries : List (Nat × Nat × Nat)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Kernel state with the pool entries (material §4), the next fresh pool identity ("jamais
réutilisée pendant l'exécution") and the ghost record of resolutions. -/
structure PS where
  s : S3
  pools : List Pool
  nId : Nat
  res : List Res

/-- Outcomes of a pool operation (material §4: `ok | fail | reject`): `fail` is a defined failure
that leaves the state unchanged, as for `alloc` and `issue` (MM-03.3 §3.1). -/
inductive POutcome where
  | ok (ps : PS)
  | fail (ps : PS)
  | reject

/-- The pool read as an arena entry with nothing available or issued, to reuse the metadata right
and the arena invariant of MM-03.3 §6 (`MetaRight`, `ArenaInv`). -/
def Pool.asArena (pl : Pool) : Arena := ⟨pl.storage, pl.internal, [], []⟩

/-- Right to update the pool value (material §4, `allocSlot` and `freeSlot`: "`Modify` exerçable
ou `writeShared` sur métadonnées `SharedMutable`"): the metadata right of the arena (MM-03.3 §6,
`MetaRight`), read on the holder of `internal`. -/
def PoolRight (k : K) (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (via : Nat) : Prop := MetaRight k s pl.asArena via

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (via : Nat) :
    Decidable (PoolRight k s pl via) := by
  unfold PoolRight; infer_instance

/-- Place of slot `i` (0 if the slot does not exist). -/
def slotPlace (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) : Nat := ((pl.slots[i]?).map (·.place)).getD 0

/-- The pool with its slot `i` replaced. -/
def setSlot (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : Pool := { pl with slots := pl.slots.set i sl }

/-- The extended state with its pool `j` replaced. -/
def setPool (ps : PS) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) : PS := { ps with pools := ps.pools.set j pl }

/-! ## `newPool storage internal` (material §4) -/

/-- Preconditions of `newPool storage internal` (material §4: "préconditions de `newArena` (F1, F2,
J1)"): those of `newArena` (MM-03.3 §6, O17), read literally, so clause 4 speaks of the arenas of
the state. -/
def NewPoolPre (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Prop := NewArenaPre s storage internal

instance (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Decidable (NewPoolPre s storage internal) := by
  unfold NewPoolPre; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `newPool storage internal` (material §4): a pool with a fresh identity, one free
entry of generation 0 per child of the storage (the entries are the parts of `storage`, report (f)),
and the kernel state unchanged. -/
def newPoolEff (ps : PS) (storage internal : Nat) : PS :=
  { ps with
    pools := ps.pools ++ [⟨ps.nId, storage, internal,
      (kids ps.s.P storage).map fun q => ⟨q, 0, false⟩⟩]
    nId := ps.nId + 1 }

/-- `newPool storage internal : ok | reject` as a relation (material §4). -/
def NewPoolStep (storage internal : Nat) (ps : PS) : Outcome3 PS → Prop :=
  Guarded (NewPoolPre ps.s storage internal) (newPoolEff ps storage internal)

/-! ## `allocSlot pool dst` (material §4) -/

/-- First free entry of a list of slots, counted from `i`. -/
def firstFreeF : Nat → List Slot → Option Nat
  | _, [] => none
  | i, sl :: l => if sl.live then firstFreeF (i + 1) l else some i

/-- First free entry of a pool (report (f): the material does not say which free entry). -/
def firstFree (pl : Pool) : Option Nat := firstFreeF 0 pl.slots

/-- Static preconditions of `allocSlot pool dst` (material §4): the right to update the pool value;
`dst` a usable leaf, not `Init`, holding no active authority, under exercisable `Modify`. The size
of a handle is not represented: MM-03 has no sizes (report (f)). -/
def AllocSlotStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (via dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  PoolRight k s pl via ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧ isLeaf s.P dst ∧
    s.I dst ≠ .init ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst)
      True

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (via dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (AllocSlotStatic k s pl via dst) := by
  unfold AllocSlotStatic; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `allocSlot` on the entry `i` of the pool `j` (material §4): the entry becomes live,
its content is not changed (the material says it stays `Uninit`, which holds when it was `Uninit`:
report, (g)), the handle is written into `dst`, which alone becomes `Init`. -/
def allocSlotEff (ps : PS) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) (dst : Nat) : PS :=
  { setPool ps j (setSlot pl i { sl with live := true }) with s := write3Eff ps.s [dst] }

/-- The handle written by `allocSlot` into its destination (material §4: `(id, slot, gen)`). -/
def slotHandle (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) : Option Handle :=
  (pl.slots[i]?).map fun sl => ⟨pl.id, i, sl.gen⟩

/-- `allocSlot pool dst : ok | fail | reject` as a relation (material §4): `reject` when a static
precondition fails or the pool does not exist; `fail`, state unchanged, when no entry is free;
`ok` otherwise, on the first free entry. -/
inductive AllocSlotStep (k : K) (j via dst : Nat) (ps : PS) : POutcome → Prop where
  | ok {pl : Pool} {i : Nat} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl →
      AllocSlotStatic k ps.s pl via dst → firstFree pl = some i → pl.slots[i]? = some sl →
      AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps (.ok (allocSlotEff ps j pl i sl dst))
  | fail {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → AllocSlotStatic k ps.s pl via dst →
      firstFree pl = none → AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps (.fail ps)
  | reject {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ AllocSlotStatic k ps.s pl via dst →
      AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps .reject
  | none : ps.pools[j]? = none → AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps .reject

/-! ## `resolve h m` and `resolveMany hs m` (material §4) -/

/-- The handle designates a live entry of the pool, at its generation (material §4, `resolve`:
`fail` "si `h.id` n'est pas l'identité du pool, si `h.gen` diffère de la génération de l'entrée,
ou si l'entrée est libre"). A slot index outside the pool designates no entry (report (f)). -/
def HandleOK (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Prop :=
  h.id = pl.id ∧ OptP (pl.slots[h.slot]?) (fun sl => sl.gen = h.gen ∧ sl.live = true) False

instance (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Decidable (HandleOK pl h) := by
  unfold HandleOK; infer_instance

/-- Right of the pool value to exercise `internal` at mode `m` (material §4, `resolve`): the
precondition of `derive` (MM-03.3 §3, O1) of the companion, from `internal`, on the whole storage.
It reads the effective mode of `internal`, so an active `Modify` companion rejects every new
resolution, whatever the handles (material §4, H31a). -/
def ResolveRight (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : Prop := DerivePre s pl.internal pl.storage m

instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : Decidable (ResolveRight s pl m) := by
  unfold ResolveRight; infer_instance

/-- State after the compound borrow of one entry (material §4): the companion `s.A.length`,
derived from `internal` on the storage, then the entry authority `s.A.length + 1`, derived from the
companion on the place `q` of the entry, both at mode `m`, held by the current frame. -/
def resolveS (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
  deriveEff (deriveEff s pl.internal pl.storage m) s.A.length q m

/-- `resolve h m : ok | fail | reject` on the pool `j` as a relation (material §4): `reject` when
the right fails; then `fail`, state unchanged, when the handle is stale, of another pool or names
a free entry; `ok` with the compound borrow, recorded with the resolved generation. The derive of
the entry is a kernel step: its precondition is checked (`noEntry`). -/
inductive ResolveStep (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (m : Mode) (ps : PS) : POutcome → Prop where
  | ok {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → HandleOK pl h →
      pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl →
      DerivePre (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length sl.place m →
      ResolveStep j h m ps (.ok { ps with
        s := resolveS ps.s pl sl.place m
        res := ps.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, ps.s.A.length, m,
          [(ps.s.A.length + 1, h.slot, h.gen)]⟩] })
  | fail {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → ¬ HandleOK pl h →
      ResolveStep j h m ps (.fail ps)
  | reject {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ ResolveRight ps.s pl m →
      ResolveStep j h m ps .reject
  | noEntry {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m →
      HandleOK pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl →
      ¬ DerivePre (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length sl.place m →
      ResolveStep j h m ps .reject
  | none : ps.pools[j]? = none → ResolveStep j h m ps .reject

/-- The handles of a batch all designate live entries of the pool at their generation, and pairwise
distinct entries (material §4, `resolveMany`: `fail` "si un handle est périmé ou d'un autre pool,
ou si deux handles désignent la même entrée"). -/
def BatchOK (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) : Prop :=
  (∀ h ∈ hs, HandleOK pl h) ∧ (hs.map (·.slot)).Nodup

instance (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) : Decidable (BatchOK pl hs) := by
  unfold BatchOK; infer_instance

/-- Regions of the entries of a batch: the footprint of each designated entry. -/
def batchRegions (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) : List (List Nat) :=
  hs.map fun h => footprint s.P (slotPlace pl h.slot)

/-- State after the compound borrow of a batch (material §4): the companion `s.A.length`, then one
entry authority per handle by `split` of the companion (MM-03.3 §3, O2). -/
def resolveManyS (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
  splitEff (deriveEff s pl.internal pl.storage m) s.A.length (batchRegions s pl hs)

/-- Entry authorities of a batch with their slot and generation: the `i`-th split authority has the
identity `c + 1 + i` for the companion `c`. -/
def batchEntries (c : Nat) (hs : List Handle) : List (Nat × Nat × Nat) :=
  mapI (fun i h => (i, h.slot, h.gen)) (c + 1) hs

/-- `resolveMany hs m : ok | fail | reject` on the pool `j` as a relation (material §4): `reject`
when the right fails; then `fail`, state unchanged and no authority created (atomicity), when the
batch is not valid; `ok` with the compound borrow when the `split` of the companion is accepted,
`reject` otherwise (`noSplit`). -/
inductive ResolveManyStep (k : K) (j : Nat) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) (ps : PS) :
    POutcome → Prop where
  | ok {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → BatchOK pl hs →
      SplitPre k (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length
        (batchRegions ps.s pl hs) →
      ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps (.ok { ps with
        s := resolveManyS ps.s pl hs m
        res := ps.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, ps.s.A.length, m,
          batchEntries ps.s.A.length hs⟩] })
  | fail {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → ¬ BatchOK pl hs →
      ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps (.fail ps)
  | reject {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ ResolveRight ps.s pl m →
      ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps .reject
  | noSplit {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → BatchOK pl hs →
      ¬ SplitPre k (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length
        (batchRegions ps.s pl hs) →
      ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps .reject
  | none : ps.pools[j]? = none → ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps .reject

/-! ## `unresolve` (material §4) -/

/-- Releases the authorities of a list in order (MM-03.3 §3, O3); `none` as soon as a release is
rejected. -/
def releaseAll : S3 → List Nat → Option S3
  | s, [] => some s
  | s, a :: l => if ReleasePre s a then releaseAll (releaseEff s a) l else none

/-- The resolution whose companion is `c`. -/
def findRes (ps : PS) (c : Nat) : Option Res := ps.res.find? fun r => r.comp == c

/-- `unresolve` of the resolution of companion `c` as a relation (material §4: "`release` des
autorités d'entrée, puis de la compagne"): `ok` when every release is accepted, `reject`
otherwise or when `c` is no companion. -/
inductive UnresolveStep (c : Nat) (ps : PS) : POutcome → Prop where
  | ok {r : Res} {s' : S3} : findRes ps c = some r →
      releaseAll ps.s (r.entries.map (·.1) ++ [r.comp]) = some s' →
      UnresolveStep c ps (.ok { ps with s := s' })
  | reject {r : Res} : findRes ps c = some r →
      releaseAll ps.s (r.entries.map (·.1) ++ [r.comp]) = none → UnresolveStep c ps .reject
  | none : findRes ps c = none → UnresolveStep c ps .reject

/-! ## `freeSlot h` (material §4) -/

/-- The handle is current for the pool (material §4, `freeSlot`: `fail` "si `h` est périmé ou d'un
autre pool"): same identity, an existing entry of the same generation. -/
def HandleCur (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Prop :=
  h.id = pl.id ∧ OptP (pl.slots[h.slot]?) (fun sl => sl.gen = h.gen) False

instance (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Decidable (HandleCur pl h) := by
  unfold HandleCur; infer_instance

/-- An active authority derived from `internal` covers a leaf of the place `q` of an entry
(material §4, `freeSlot`: `reject` "si une autorité active dérivée de `internal` couvre
l'entrée"). -/
def EntryBorrowed (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active j ∧ pl.internal ∈ s.ancs j ∧
    ∃ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∈ footprint s.P q

instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Decidable (EntryBorrowed s pl q) := by
  unfold EntryBorrowed; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `freeSlot` on the entry `i` of the pool `j` (material §4): the end of the content of
the entry by `endUse` (MM-03.3 §3, O12), then the entry is free and its generation incremented. -/
def freeSlotEff (ps : PS) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : PS :=
  { setPool ps j (setSlot pl i ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩) with
    s := endUseEff ps.s sl.place }

/-- `freeSlot h : ok | fail | reject` on the pool `j` as a relation (material §4), in order:
`reject` without the right to update the pool value; `fail`, state unchanged, for a stale handle
or one of another pool; `reject` when an active authority derived from `internal` covers the
entry; `reject` when a precondition of `endUse` fails; `ok` otherwise. -/
inductive FreeSlotStep (k : K) (j via : Nat) (h : Handle) (ps : PS) : POutcome → Prop where
  | ok {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → PoolRight k ps.s pl via →
      HandleCur pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → ¬ EntryBorrowed ps.s pl sl.place →
      EndUsePre k ps.s sl.place →
      FreeSlotStep k j via h ps (.ok (freeSlotEff ps j pl h.slot sl))
  | fail {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → PoolRight k ps.s pl via → ¬ HandleCur pl h →
      FreeSlotStep k j via h ps (.fail ps)
  | reject {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ PoolRight k ps.s pl via →
      FreeSlotStep k j via h ps .reject
  | borrowed {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → PoolRight k ps.s pl via →
      HandleCur pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → EntryBorrowed ps.s pl sl.place →
      FreeSlotStep k j via h ps .reject
  | endUse {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → PoolRight k ps.s pl via →
      HandleCur pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → ¬ EntryBorrowed ps.s pl sl.place →
      ¬ EndUsePre k ps.s sl.place → FreeSlotStep k j via h ps .reject
  | none : ps.pools[j]? = none → FreeSlotStep k j via h ps .reject

/-! ## Reachability extended with the pool (material §4, "intégration à `Reachable`") -/

/-- One step of the extended machine: a step of `Reachable` (MM-03.3 §10, `Step`) on the kernel
state, or an `ok` pool operation (material §4). -/
inductive PStep (k : K) : PS → PS → Prop where
  | kernel {ps : PS} {s' : S3} : Step k ps.s s' → PStep k ps { ps with s := s' }
  | newPool {ps ps' : PS} {st i : Nat} : NewPoolStep st i ps (.ok ps') → PStep k ps ps'
  | allocSlot {ps ps' : PS} {j via dst : Nat} : AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps (.ok ps') →
      PStep k ps ps'
  | resolve {ps ps' : PS} {j : Nat} {h : Handle} {m : Mode} : ResolveStep j h m ps (.ok ps') →
      PStep k ps ps'
  | resolveMany {ps ps' : PS} {j : Nat} {hs : List Handle} {m : Mode} :
      ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps (.ok ps') → PStep k ps ps'
  | unresolve {ps ps' : PS} {c : Nat} : UnresolveStep c ps (.ok ps') → PStep k ps ps'
  | freeSlot {ps ps' : PS} {j via : Nat} {h : Handle} : FreeSlotStep k j via h ps (.ok ps') →
      PStep k ps ps'

/-- Initial extended state: `S3.init statics` (MM-03.3.9), no pool, no resolution. -/
def PS.init (statics : Statics) : PS := ⟨S3.init statics, [], 0, []⟩

/-- States reached from the initial state by kernel, arena and pool steps (material §4, extension of
`Reachable`, MM-03.3 §10). -/
inductive PReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : PS → Prop where
  | init : ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1)) → PReach k statics (PS.init statics)
  | step {ps ps' : PS} : PReach k statics ps → PStep k ps ps' → PReach k statics ps'

/-! ## Kernel steps keep authorities and footprints (MM-03.3 §3–6) -/

/-- The authorities of `s` remain in `s'` with their mode and footprint; one active in `s'` was

(map_set_same Pool.shape hpj (setSlot_shape (x := ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩) hsl rfl))

/-! ## Theorems of the material (§4) -/

/-- `pool_resolve_stale_fails` (material §4, generation): with the right of the pool value, a handle
whose generation differs from that of its entry fails, state unchanged. -/
theorem pool_resolve_stale_fails {ps : PS} {j : Nat} {pl : Pool} {h : Handle} {m : Mode}
    {sl : Slot} (hp : ps.pools[j]? = some pl) (hR : ResolveRight ps.s pl m)
    (hsl : pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl) (hg : sl.gen ≠ h.gen) :
    ResolveStep j h m ps (.fail ps) :=
  .fail hp hR fun ⟨_, ho⟩ => by rw [hsl] at ho; exact hg ho.1

/-- `pool_resolve_other_pool_fails` (material §4, identity of the pool): with the right of the pool
value, a handle of another pool fails, state unchanged. -/
theorem pool_resolve_other_pool_fails {ps : PS} {j : Nat} {pl : Pool} {h : Handle} {m : Mode}
    (hp : ps.pools[j]? = some pl) (hR : ResolveRight ps.s pl m) (hid : h.id ≠ pl.id) :
    ResolveStep j h m ps (.fail ps) :=
  .fail hp hR fun ⟨e, _⟩ => hid e

/-- A failed resolution leaves the state unchanged (material §4, `resolve`: "`fail` (état
inchangé)"). -/
theorem pool_resolve_fail_unchanged {ps ps' : PS} {j : Nat} {h : Handle} {m : Mode}
    (hst : ResolveStep j h m ps (.fail ps')) : ps' = ps := by
  cases hst; rfl

/-- `pool_no_stale_access` (material §4): on every reached state, an active entry authority carries
the current generation of its entry, and the entry is live. -/
theorem pool_no_stale_access {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {ps : PS}
    (h : PReach k statics ps) : NoStale ps :=
  (pReach_inv hdd h).2.2.1

/-- `pool_resolve_modify_exclusive` (material §4): on every reached state, whatever the sequence of
`resolve`, `resolveMany`, `release`, `store`, `transfer` and `unresolve` (and every other step of
`PReach`), an active `Modify` companion of a pool is the only active companion of that pool: at
most one active `Modify` companion, and then no active `Observe` companion. -/
theorem pool_resolve_modify_exclusive {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {ps : PS}
    (h : PReach k statics ps) : ∀ r₁ ∈ ps.res, ∀ r₂ ∈ ps.res, r₁.pool = r₂.pool →
      ps.s.Active r₁.comp → ps.s.Active r₂.comp → r₁.mode = .modify → r₁.comp = r₂.comp := by
  intro r₁ hr₁ r₂ hr₂ hp ha₁ ha₂ hm
  refine Decidable.byContradiction fun hne => ?_
  have := (pReach_inv hdd h).2.2.2 r₁ hr₁ r₂ hr₂ hp hne ha₁ ha₂
  rw [hm] at this; cases this.1

/-- `pool_resolveMany_atomic` (material §4): a failed `resolveMany` creates no authority and
leaves the state unchanged; an accepted one creates the companion and all the entry authorities
in one step. -/
theorem pool_resolveMany_atomic {k : K} {ps ps' : PS} {j : Nat} {hs : List Handle} {m : Mode} :
    (ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps (.fail ps') → ps' = ps) ∧
    (ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps (.ok ps') → ∃ pl, ps.pools[j]? = some pl ∧ BatchOK pl hs ∧
      ps'.s = resolveManyS ps.s pl hs m ∧ ps'.s.A.length = ps.s.A.length + 1 + hs.length) := by
  refine ⟨fun h => by cases h; rfl, fun h => ?_⟩
  cases h with
  | @ok pl hp _ hB _ =>
    refine ⟨pl, hp, hB, rfl, ?_⟩
    simp only [resolveManyS, splitEff, deriveEff, S3.addAuth, batchRegions, List.length_append,
      List.length_map, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]

/-- `pool_resolveMany_distinct` (material §4, dynamic distinctness): with the right of the pool
value, two handles of a batch designating the same entry make `resolveMany` fail; an accepted batch
designates pairwise distinct entries. -/
theorem pool_resolveMany_distinct {k : K} {ps ps' : PS} {j : Nat} {pl : Pool} {hs : List Handle}
    {m : Mode} :
    (ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → ¬ (hs.map (·.slot)).Nodup →
      ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps (.fail ps)) ∧
    (ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps (.ok ps') → (hs.map (·.slot)).Nodup) := by
  refine ⟨fun hp hR hd => .fail hp hR fun hB => hd hB.2, fun h => ?_⟩
  cases h with
  | ok _ _ hB _ => exact hB.2

/-- `pool_freeSlot_ends_content` (material §4): after `freeSlot`, the kernel state is the result of
an accepted `endUse` of the entry (MM-03.3 §3, O12), whose leaves are `Uninit`, and the entry is
free with its generation incremented. -/
theorem pool_freeSlot_ends_content {k : K} {ps ps' : PS} {j via : Nat} {h : Handle}
    (hst : FreeSlotStep k j via h ps (.ok ps')) :
    ∃ pl sl, ps.pools[j]? = some pl ∧ pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl ∧
      EndUseStep k sl.place ps.s (.ok ps'.s) ∧
      (∀ l ∈ footprint ps.s.P sl.place, ps'.s.I l = .uninit) ∧
      ps'.pools[j]? = some (setSlot pl h.slot ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩) := by
  cases hst with
  | @ok pl sl hp _ _ hsl _ hE =>
    refine ⟨pl, sl, hp, hsl, Guarded.ok hE, fun l hl => ?_, getElem?_set_eq' hp⟩
    show (cleanup (endUseS ps.s sl.place)).I l = .uninit
    simp [cleanup, endUseS, hl]

/-! ## `PoolInv` read literally (material §4) -/

/-- Second clause of `PoolInv` (material §4), literally, for the pool `pl`: every active authority
derived from a companion of the pool and covering a leaf of an entry "porte la génération courante
de l'entrée": it is, or descends from, an entry authority of that entry tagged with its current
generation; and the entry is live. -/
def PoolInvGen (ps : PS) (pl : Pool) : Prop :=
  ∀ r ∈ ps.res, r.pool = pl.id → ∀ j ∈ List.range ps.s.A.length, ps.s.Active j →
    r.comp ∈ ps.s.ancs j → ∀ i ∈ List.range pl.slots.length,
      (∃ l ∈ ps.s.afp j, l ∈ footprint ps.s.P (slotPlace pl i)) →
      OptP (pl.slots[i]?) (fun sl => sl.live = true ∧ ∃ e ∈ r.entries, e.2.1 = i ∧
        e.2.2 = sl.gen ∧ (e.1 = j ∨ e.1 ∈ ps.s.ancs j)) False

instance (ps : PS) (pl : Pool) : Decidable (PoolInvGen ps pl) := by
  unfold PoolInvGen; infer_instance

/-- Third clause of `PoolInv` (material §4), literally, for the pool `pl`: "toute compagne active a
au plus les autorités d'entrée de sa résolution pour descendants", read on active descendants. -/
def PoolInvDesc (ps : PS) (pl : Pool) : Prop :=
  ∀ r ∈ ps.res, r.pool = pl.id → ps.s.Active r.comp → ∀ j ∈ List.range ps.s.A.length,
    ps.s.Active j → r.comp ∈ ps.s.ancs j → j ∈ r.entries.map (·.1)

instance (ps : PS) (pl : Pool) : Decidable (PoolInvDesc ps pl) := by
  unfold PoolInvDesc; infer_instance

/-- First clause of `PoolInv` (material §4) for the pool `pl`: entries pairwise disjoint and within
the storage. -/
def PoolInvDisj (ps : PS) (pl : Pool) : Prop :=
  (∀ i₁ ∈ List.range pl.slots.length, ∀ i₂ ∈ List.range pl.slots.length, i₁ ≠ i₂ →
    ∀ l ∈ footprint ps.s.P (slotPlace pl i₁), l ∉ footprint ps.s.P (slotPlace pl i₂)) ∧
  ∀ sl ∈ pl.slots, ∀ l ∈ footprint ps.s.P sl.place, l ∈ footprint ps.s.P pl.storage

instance (ps : PS) (pl : Pool) : Decidable (PoolInvDisj ps pl) := by
  unfold PoolInvDisj; infer_instance

/-- `PoolInv` of the material (§4), literally, for every live pool (`internal` active): the three
clauses `PoolInvDisj`, `PoolInvGen` and `PoolInvDesc`. -/
def PoolInv (ps : PS) : Prop :=
  ∀ pl ∈ ps.pools, ps.s.Active pl.internal →
    PoolInvDisj ps pl ∧ PoolInvGen ps pl ∧ PoolInvDesc ps pl

instance (ps : PS) : Decidable (PoolInv ps) := by unfold PoolInv; infer_instance

/-! ## Executable steps

A decidable step function for the extended machine, used by the case files to build reached
states: `prun` runs a list of operations and returns the final state when every step is `ok`
(`prun_reach`). -/

/-- An operation of the extended machine with its arguments: the steps of `Reachable`
(MM-03.3 §3–6) and the pool operations (material §4). -/
inductive Op where
  | derive (src q : Nat) (m : Mode)
  | split (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat))
  | release (a : Nat)
  | transfer (src dst : Nat)
  | depend (q x : Nat)
  | enter (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat))
  | exit
  | read (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  | write (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  | writeShared (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  | pin (p : Nat)
  | unpin (p : Nat)
  | endUse (p : Nat)
  | free (p auth : Nat)
  | alloc (pr ow : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat))
  | store (a p : Nat)
  | newArena (st i : Nat)
  | issue (i via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat)
  | reset (i via : Nat)
  | newPool (st i : Nat)
  | allocSlot (j via dst : Nat)
  | resolve (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (m : Mode)
  | resolveMany (j : Nat) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode)
  | unresolve (c : Nat)
  | freeSlot (j via : Nat) (h : Handle)

section Exec
variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- `ok` outcome of a step of `Reachable` (MM-03.3 §3–6), `none` otherwise. -/
def kexec (s : S3) : Op → Option S3
  | .derive src q m => if DerivePre s src q m then some (deriveEff s src q m) else none
  | .split src rs => if SplitPre k s src rs then some (splitEff s src rs) else none
  | .release a => if ReleasePre s a then some (releaseEff s a) else none
  | .transfer src dst => if TransferPre k s src dst then some (transferEff s src dst) else none
  | .depend q x => if DependPre s q x then some (dependEff s q x) else none
  | .enter ps ls => if EnterPre s ps ls then some (enterEff s ps ls) else none
  | .exit => if ExitPre k s then some (exitEff s) else none
  | .read a ls => if canRead3 s a ls then some s else none
  | .write a ls => if canWrite3 s a ls then some (write3Eff s ls) else none
  | .writeShared a ls => if WriteSharedPre k s a ls then some (write3Eff s ls) else none
  | .pin p => if PinPre s p then some (pinEff s p true) else none
  | .unpin p => if UnpinPre k s p then some (pinEff s p false) else none
  | .endUse p => if EndUsePre k s p then some (endUseEff s p) else none
  | .free p auth => if FreePre k s p auth then some (freeEff s p) else none
  | .alloc pr ow ls =>
    if AllocStatic k s pr ow ls ∧ k.Satisfiable pr ls s then some (allocEff s pr ow ls) else none
  | .store a p => if StorePre s a p then some (storeEff s a p) else none
  | .newArena st i => if NewArenaPre s st i then some (newArenaEff s st i) else none
  | .issue i via region dst =>
    match s.arenas[i]? with
    | some ar =>
      if IssueStatic k s ar via region dst ∧ Avail ar region ∧ IssueRight s ar region ∧
          AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 then
        some (arenaSet (issueEff s ar region dst).1 i (issueEff s ar region dst).2)
      else none
    | none => none
  | .reset i via => if ResetAtPre k s i via then some (resetAtEff s i) else none
  | _ => none

/-- `ok` outcome of a step of the extended machine, `none` otherwise. -/
def pexec (ps : PS) : Op → Option PS
  | .newPool st i => if NewPoolPre ps.s st i then some (newPoolEff ps st i) else none
  | .allocSlot j via dst =>
    match ps.pools[j]? with
    | some pl =>
      if AllocSlotStatic k ps.s pl via dst then
        match firstFree pl with
        | some i => (pl.slots[i]?).map fun sl => allocSlotEff ps j pl i sl dst
        | none => none
      else none
    | none => none
  | .resolve j h m =>
    match ps.pools[j]? with
    | some pl =>
      match pl.slots[h.slot]? with
      | some sl =>
        if ResolveRight ps.s pl m ∧ HandleOK pl h ∧
            DerivePre (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length sl.place m then
          some { ps with
            s := resolveS ps.s pl sl.place m
            res := ps.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, ps.s.A.length, m,
              [(ps.s.A.length + 1, h.slot, h.gen)]⟩] }
        else none
      | none => none
    | none => none
  | .resolveMany j hs m =>
    match ps.pools[j]? with
    | some pl =>
      if ResolveRight ps.s pl m ∧ BatchOK pl hs ∧
          SplitPre k (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length
            (batchRegions ps.s pl hs) then
        some { ps with
          s := resolveManyS ps.s pl hs m
          res := ps.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, ps.s.A.length, m,
            batchEntries ps.s.A.length hs⟩] }
      else none
    | none => none
  | .unresolve c =>
    match findRes ps c with
    | some r => (releaseAll ps.s (r.entries.map (·.1) ++ [r.comp])).map fun s' => { ps with s := s' }
    | none => none
  | .freeSlot j via h =>
    match ps.pools[j]? with
    | some pl =>
      match pl.slots[h.slot]? with
      | some sl =>
        if PoolRight k ps.s pl via ∧ HandleCur pl h ∧ ¬ EntryBorrowed ps.s pl sl.place ∧
            EndUsePre k ps.s sl.place then
          some (freeSlotEff ps j pl h.slot sl)
        else none
      | none => none
    | none => none
  | o => (kexec k ps.s o).map fun s' => { ps with s := s' }

/-- Runs a list of operations; `some` of the final state when every step is `ok`. -/
def prun (ps : PS) : List Op → Option PS
  | [] => some ps
  | o :: os => (pexec k ps o).bind fun ps' => prun ps' os

end Exec

section ExecSound

import Ern.Derived.Arena
import Ern.MM23

/-!
# DataStack, a library instance over the kernel (derivability pass 0.1, question 2)

A stack administers a storage through an authority `internal` held by the stack value, as an arena
does (candidate Spec 1 §36, §46), with library metadata: the ordered leaves of the storage, the
top, the issued blocks and the live marks. Its operations are built on kernel steps and on the
derived `issue` and `reset` of question 1 (`Ern.Derived.Arena`):

* `push`: the restricted `issue` at the top, its static clauses (§77.1, §77.2) checked before the
  room, realised by `split` of `internal` on the cells then `store` of the block into the
  destination; `fail` when no room is left;
* `mark`: a mark (stack, fresh identifier, top), metadata only;
* `rewind`: the derived `reset` on the cells above the mark, `split` of `internal` on them then
  `release` of the derived authority; `fail` for a mark that is not live in the stack;
* `grow`: in place, `release` of the last block, then the derived `issue` of a region of the same
  base and of larger size into the same destination, which is `Init`; `fail` when no room is left.

Every `ok` step of the library takes kernel steps of `Reachable` only (`dexec_reach`). The theorems
of the brief are `rewind_rejects_live_above`, `mark_no_aba` (with `rewind_removes`),
`rewind_keeps_older_marks`,
`grow_same_base`, `grow_keeps_prefix_init` and `grow_keeps_prefix_bytes` (through the refinement
`Ern.MM23`, unchanged). The decisions the brief does not settle are listed in the report
(`formal/reports/Derivability_v0.1.md`, (c) and (f)).
-/

namespace Ern.Lib.DataStack

open Ern.MM03 Ern.HandlePool Ern.MM03.Horrors Ern.Derived.Arena

/-- A block issued by a stack: base and size in the cells of the stack, authority, destination. -/
structure Blk where
  base : Nat
  size : Nat
  auth : Nat
  dst : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- A mark (brief: "(pile, identifiant frais, sommet)"). -/
structure Mark where
  stack : Nat
  id : Nat
  top : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- A stack (brief: "stockage, `internal`, sommet, liste ordonnée des marques vivantes"); `cells`
are the ordered leaves of the storage, its footprint at creation; `blocks` the issued blocks,
oldest first. The stack value is the holder of `internal`. -/
structure Stack where
  storage : Nat
  internal : Nat
  cells : List Nat
  top : Nat
  blocks : List Blk
  marks : List Mark
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- State of the library: the kernel state, the stacks (the identity of a stack is its index) and
the next fresh mark identifier. -/
structure DS where
  s : S3
  stacks : List Stack
  fresh : Nat

/-- Outcome of a library operation; `fail` leaves the state unchanged (§58). -/
inductive Out where
  | ok (d : DS)
  | fail
  | reject

/-- The `n` cells of the stack from the index `b`. -/
def cellsOf (st : Stack) (b n : Nat) : List Nat := (st.cells.drop b).take n

/-- The cells above the mark `m`, from its top to the current top: those that `rewind m` returns
to the available part (brief: "les régions au-dessus de `m`"). A region issued after `m` and still
below the top lies there, but not every such region does: a block grown after `m` from a base below
`m` starts below it, and a region issued after `m` and returned by an intermediate `rewind` lies
above the current top (`case_rewind_reading`; report, (f)). -/
34:structure Blk where
42:structure Mark where
51:structure Stack where
62:structure DS where
68:inductive Out where
74:def cellsOf (st : Stack) (b n : Nat) : List Nat := (st.cells.drop b).take n
81:def above (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : List Nat := cellsOf st m.top (st.top - m.top)
84:def Stack.arena (st : Stack) : Arena := ⟨st.storage, st.internal, [], []⟩
87:def NoHeld (s : S3) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=

def above (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : List Nat := cellsOf st m.top (st.top - m.top)

/-- The stack seen as an administration of its storage, for `MetaRightM` and `blockOf`. -/
def Stack.arena (st : Stack) : Arena := ⟨st.storage, st.internal, [], []⟩

/-- No active authority is held by the destination (O8.2, §77.2). -/
def NoHeld (s : S3) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True

instance (s : S3) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (NoHeld s dst) := by unfold NoHeld; infer_instance

/-- Static preconditions of `push` of the cells `r`, checked before the room (§58, §77.4), those of
the restricted `issue` (`IssueStaticR`, §77.1 and §77.2): the stack is live, the current frame has
exercisable `Modify` on the stack value (`MetaRightM`), and the destination is a usable leaf under
exercisable `Modify`, not `Init`, holding no active authority and outside `r`. The brief's "`fail`
si pas de place" stands for both the inclusion of the region in the storage (a static clause of
§77.2) and its availability (§77.4): `push` fails when the cells requested go past the storage. -/
def PushStatic (s : S3) (st : Stack) (r : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Active st.internal ∧ MetaRightM s st.arena ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ isLeaf s.P dst ∧
    HasRight s .modify dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ NoHeld s dst ∧ dst ∉ r

instance (s : S3) (st : Stack) (r : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (PushStatic s st r dst) := by
  unfold PushStatic; infer_instance

/-- The derived `issue` (question 1, `issue_as_kernel_split`): `split` of `internal` on `r`, then
`store` of the block into `dst`. -/
def IssueSeq (k : K) (s : S3) (st : Stack) (r : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  SplitPre k s st.internal [r] ∧ StorePre (s.addAuth (blockOf s st.arena r)) s.A.length dst

instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (st : Stack)
    (r : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (IssueSeq k s st r dst) := by
  unfold IssueSeq; infer_instance

/-- Arrival state of the derived `issue`. -/
def issueSeqEff (s : S3) (st : Stack) (r : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : S3 :=
  storeEff (s.addAuth (blockOf s st.arena r)) s.A.length dst

/-- The derived `reset` on the cells above `m` (question 1, `reset_as_kernel`): `split` of
`internal` on them, then `release` of the derived authority. -/
def RewindSeq (k : K) (s : S3) (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Prop :=
  SplitPre k s st.internal [above st m] ∧
    ReleasePre (s.addAuth (blockOf s st.arena (above st m))) s.A.length

instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (st : Stack) (m : Mark) :
    Decidable (RewindSeq k s st m) := by
  unfold RewindSeq; infer_instance

/-- The guard of §56 for `internal` `i`: no live arena and no live stack already uses it. -/
def Guard56 (d : DS) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ ar ∈ d.s.arenas, d.s.Active ar.internal → ar.internal ≠ i) ∧
    ∀ x ∈ d.stacks, d.s.Active x.internal → x.internal ≠ i

instance (d : DS) (i : Nat) : Decidable (Guard56 d i) := by unfold Guard56; infer_instance

section Ops
variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- Creation of a stack on `storage` administered by `internal` (as O17, §76): the preconditions of
`newArena` and the guard of §56 on both registries, arenas and stacks. -/
def newStack (d : DS) (storage i : Nat) : Out :=
  if NewArenaPreNG d.s storage i ∧ Guard56 d i then
    .ok { d with stacks := d.stacks ++ [⟨storage, i, footprint d.s.P storage, 0, [], []⟩] }
  else .reject

/-- `push size dst` on the stack `j` (brief: "émission au sommet (`issue` restreint)"): the static
clauses of the restricted `issue` (`PushStatic`), then `fail` when fewer than `size` cells are left,
then the derived `issue` of the `size` cells at the top into `dst`. Its kernel part being the
derived `issue`, `push` also asks clause 5 of `store` (O8.5), which the restricted `issue` does not
(`issue_as_kernel_split`, for registered arenas). Its exact relation to `IssueR` is not proven here:
a stack is not an entry of the arena registry, and the room stands for availability. `size` may be
zero: the block then has an empty footprint, as the
restricted `issue` of the empty region (`ce_empty_region`), and it blocks no `rewind`. -/
def push (d : DS) (j size dst : Nat) : Out :=
  match d.stacks[j]? with
  | none => .reject
  | some st =>
    if PushStatic d.s st (cellsOf st st.top size) dst then
      if st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length then
        if IssueSeq k d.s st (cellsOf st st.top size) dst then
          .ok { d with
            s := issueSeqEff d.s st (cellsOf st st.top size) dst
            stacks := d.stacks.set j
              { st with
                top := st.top + size
                blocks := st.blocks ++ [⟨st.top, size, d.s.A.length, dst⟩] } }
        else .reject
      else .fail
    else .reject

/-- `mark` on the stack `j` (brief): `ok`, a mark (stack, fresh identifier, top) appended to the
live marks. -/
def mark (d : DS) (j : Nat) : Out :=
  match d.stacks[j]? with
  | none => .reject
  | some st => .ok { d with
      stacks := d.stacks.set j { st with marks := st.marks ++ [⟨j, d.fresh, st.top⟩] }
      fresh := d.fresh + 1 }

/-- `rewind m` on the stack `j` (brief): `fail` when `m` is not a live mark of the stack; then the
derived `reset` on the cells above `m`, `split` of `internal` on them and `release`, which rejects
when an active authority derived from `internal` covers one of them (`rewind_rejects_live_above`)
and also when the current frame cannot exercise `internal` at `Modify` (O2.1, the restricted
`MetaRight` of §78.1); `ok`: the top returns to the top of `m`, the blocks whose base is above it
are forgotten, `m` and the later marks are removed, the older marks stay (`rewind_removes`). A stack
that does not exist rejects (no stack value). -/
def rewind (d : DS) (j : Nat) (m : Mark) : Out :=
  match d.stacks[j]? with
  | none => .reject
  | some st =>
    if m ∈ st.marks then
      if RewindSeq k d.s st m then
        .ok { d with
          s := releaseEff (d.s.addAuth (blockOf d.s st.arena (above st m))) d.s.A.length
          stacks := d.stacks.set j
            { st with
              top := m.top
              blocks := st.blocks.filter (·.base < m.top)
              marks := st.marks.takeWhile (· ≠ m) } }
      else .reject
    else .fail

/-- `grow b extra` on the stack `j` (brief: in place only). Static clauses, checked before the room
(§58): `b` is the authority of the last block, at the top, `extra` is positive ("taille plus
grande"), `b` can be released, the stack is live, the current frame has exercisable `Modify` on
the stack value (`MetaRightM`), and the destination recorded for the block is outside the new region
(§77.2, "vérifiée avant le `fail` de disponibilité"). `fail` when fewer than `extra` cells follow
the block; otherwise `release` of `b`, then the derived `issue` of the region of the same base and of
size `size + extra` into that destination. The other clauses on the destination concern the state
after the release and are those of `store`. The destination is `Init` (the first `store` wrote it)
unless the block value was moved out of it (`Moved`): the derived `issue` accepts both (O8.2), the
restricted `issue` rejects the `Init` case (§77.2, report (c)). -/
def grow (d : DS) (j b extra : Nat) : Out :=
  match d.stacks[j]? with
  | none => .reject
  | some st =>
    match st.blocks.getLast? with
    | none => .reject
    | some x =>
      if 0 < extra ∧ x.auth = b ∧ x.base + x.size = st.top ∧ ReleasePre d.s b ∧
          d.s.Active st.internal ∧ MetaRightM d.s st.arena ∧
          x.dst ∉ cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra) then
        if x.base + x.size + extra ≤ st.cells.length then
          if IssueSeq k (releaseEff d.s b) st (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst then
            .ok { d with
              s := issueSeqEff (releaseEff d.s b) st (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst
              stacks := d.stacks.set j
                { st with
                  top := x.base + x.size + extra
                  blocks := st.blocks.dropLast ++ [⟨x.base, x.size + extra, d.s.A.length, x.dst⟩] } }
          else .reject
        else .fail
      else .reject

/-- Operations of a run of the library: a kernel or arena step, or a stack operation. -/
inductive DOp where
  | kernel (o : Op)
  | newStack (storage i : Nat)
  | push (j size dst : Nat)
  | mark (j : Nat)
  | rewind (j : Nat) (m : Mark)
  | grow (j b extra : Nat)

/-- The guard of §56 that a kernel `newArena` adds in the library: the registry of the stacks. -/
def KGuard (d : DS) : Op → Prop
  | .newArena _ i => ∀ x ∈ d.stacks, d.s.Active x.internal → x.internal ≠ i
  | _ => True

instance (d : DS) (o : Op) : Decidable (KGuard d o) := by
  cases o <;> unfold KGuard <;> infer_instance

/-- A step of the library. A kernel `newArena` also consults the registry of the stacks (§56). -/
def dexec (d : DS) : DOp → Out
  | .kernel o =>
    if KGuard d o then
      match kexec k d.s o with
      | some s' => .ok { d with s := s' }
      | none => .reject
    else .reject
  | .newStack st i => DataStack.newStack d st i
  | .push j size dst => DataStack.push k d j size dst
  | .mark j => DataStack.mark d j
  | .rewind j m => DataStack.rewind k d j m
  | .grow j b extra => DataStack.grow k d j b extra

/-- A run of the library: `some` of the final state when every step is `ok`. -/
def drun (d : DS) : List DOp → Option DS
  | [] => some d
  | o :: os =>
    match dexec k d o with
    | .ok d' => drun d' os
    | _ => none

end Ops

/-- The initial state of the library. -/
def DS.init : DS := ⟨S3.init [], [], 0⟩

/-! ## Inversion of the `ok` steps -/

Runs from `DS.init` under the test contracts `K0`; each statement includes that the run is `ok`
(`isSome`), so that `final` is its state; every verdict by `decide`. -/

def Out.isOk : Out → Bool
  | .ok _ => true
  | _ => false

def Out.isFail : Out → Bool
  | .fail => true
  | _ => false

def Out.isReject : Out → Bool
  | .reject => true
  | _ => false

/-- The state of a run from `DS.init` (`DS.init` when a step is not `ok`). -/
def final (os : List DOp) : DS := (drun K0 DS.init os).getD DS.init

/-- The kernel state of an `ok` run of the library is reached. -/
theorem final_reach {os : List DOp} (h : (drun K0 DS.init os).isSome = true) :
    Reachable K0 [] (final os).s := by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.1 h
  have := drun_reach (statics := []) (show Reachable K0 [] DS.init.s from .init (by decide)) hd
  simp only [final, hd, Option.getD_some]; exact this

/-- A cell of the storage `p`. -/
abbrev cellOf (p : Nat) : Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat := (some p, none, 0)

/-- One stack: frame 1 with the leaves 0 (stack value), 2, 3, 4 (cells of the storage 1), 5, 6, 7
(destinations), of root authorities 0 (on 0), 1 (on 1), 2, 3, 4 (on 5, 6, 7); `internal` 5 derived
from 1 and stored into 0; the stack 0 created on 1 with `internal` 5. -/
def setup1 : List DOp :=
  [.kernel (.enter [] [lf, lf, cellOf 1, cellOf 1, cellOf 1, lf, lf, lf]),
    .kernel (.derive 1 1 .modify), .kernel (.store 5 0), .newStack 1 5]

/-- Mark `⟨0, 0, 0⟩`, `push 2` into 5 (block 6 on `[2, 3]`), mark `⟨0, 1, 2⟩`, `push 1` into 6
(block 7 on `[4]`). -/
def opsR : List DOp := setup1 ++ [.mark 0, .push 0 2 5, .mark 0, .push 0 1 6]

/-- **`rewind` refused then accepted**: `rewind ⟨0, 1, 2⟩` is rejected while the block 7, derived
from `internal`, covers the cell 4 above the mark (`rewind_rejects_live_above`); after the release
of 7 it is accepted: the top returns to 2, the mark `⟨0, 0, 0⟩` stays, the block 6 stays. -/
theorem case_rewind :
    (drun K0 DS.init opsR).isSome = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsR) (.rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 2⟩)).isReject = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init (opsR ++ [.kernel (.release 7), .rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 2⟩])).isSome = true ∧
    (final (opsR ++ [.kernel (.release 7), .rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 2⟩])).stacks.map
      (fun st => (st.top, st.blocks, st.marks)) = [(2, [⟨0, 2, 6, 5⟩], [⟨0, 0, 0⟩])] := by
  decide

/-- The run of `case_rewind`, then a new mark: it has the top 2 of the removed mark `⟨0, 1, 2⟩` and
the fresh identifier 2. -/
def opsA : List DOp := opsR ++ [.kernel (.release 7), .rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 2⟩, .mark 0]

/-- **ABA** (`mark_no_aba`): the top is back at 2, the position of the removed mark `⟨0, 1, 2⟩`,
and a mark `⟨0, 2, 2⟩` is live there; `rewind ⟨0, 1, 2⟩` fails, `rewind ⟨0, 2, 2⟩` is accepted. -/
theorem case_aba :
    (drun K0 DS.init opsA).isSome = true ∧
    (final opsA).stacks.map (fun st => (st.top, st.marks)) = [(2, [⟨0, 0, 0⟩, ⟨0, 2, 2⟩])] ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsA) (.rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 2⟩)).isFail = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsA) (.rewind 0 ⟨0, 2, 2⟩)).isOk = true := by
  decide

/-- The run of `case_aba`, then `grow` of the last block 6 by one cell. -/
def opsG : List DOp := opsA ++ [.grow 0 6 1]

/-- **`grow`**: `grow 6 1` is accepted in place: the last block becomes `⟨0, 3, 9, 5⟩`, of the same
base and destination, and its authority 9 covers `[2, 3, 4]`; `grow 9 1` then fails, no cell
following; `grow 6 1` is rejected, 6 being no longer the last block. -/
theorem case_grow :
    (drun K0 DS.init opsG).isSome = true ∧
    (final opsG).stacks.map (fun st => (st.top, st.blocks)) = [(3, [⟨0, 3, 9, 5⟩])] ∧
    (final opsG).s.afp 9 = [2, 3, 4] ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsG) (.grow 0 9 1)).isFail = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsG) (.grow 0 6 1)).isReject = true := by
  decide

/-- Two stacks: frame 1 with the leaves 0 and 8 (stack values), the storages 1 (cells 2, 3, 4)
and 9 (cells 10, 11), the destinations 5, 6, 7, 12, of root authorities 0 to 7; `internal` 8 on 1
stored into 0, stack 0; `internal` 9 on 9 stored into 8, stack 1. -/
def setup2 : List DOp :=
  [.kernel (.enter [] [lf, lf, cellOf 1, cellOf 1, cellOf 1, lf, lf, lf, lf, lf, cellOf 9, cellOf 9, lf]),
    .kernel (.derive 1 1 .modify), .kernel (.store 8 0), .newStack 1 8,
    .kernel (.derive 6 9 .modify), .kernel (.store 9 8), .newStack 9 9]

def opsS : List DOp := setup2 ++ [.mark 0, .push 0 1 5, .push 1 1 12, .mark 1]

/-- **Several stacks**: the guard of §56 rejects a second stack with `internal` 8, and a kernel
`newArena` with `internal` 8, which the kernel alone accepts; each stack has its top, blocks and
marks; `rewind` of stack 0 to its mark is rejected while its block 10 lives, a mark of stack 1 is not
a live mark of stack 0 (`fail`), stack 1 rewinds to its mark and pushes again. -/
theorem case_stacks :
    (drun K0 DS.init setup2).isSome = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final setup2) (.newStack 1 8)).isReject = true ∧
    (kexec K0 (final setup2).s (.newArena 1 8)).isSome = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final setup2) (.kernel (.newArena 1 8))).isReject = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init opsS).isSome = true ∧
    (final opsS).stacks.map (fun st => (st.internal, st.top, st.blocks, st.marks)) =
      [(8, 1, [⟨0, 1, 10, 5⟩], [⟨0, 0, 0⟩]), (9, 1, [⟨0, 1, 11, 12⟩], [⟨1, 1, 1⟩])] ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsS) (.rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩)).isReject = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsS) (.rewind 0 ⟨1, 1, 1⟩)).isFail = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init (opsS ++ [.rewind 1 ⟨1, 1, 1⟩, .push 1 1 6])).isSome = true := by
  decide

/-- Frame use: the caller derives 6 from the root of the stack value at `Modify` and passes it to a
callee with one local 8; the callee marks the stack at entry and pushes 2 cells into its local
(block 8). At exit, `rewind` is rejected while the block lives; after `endUse` of the local, which
releases the block, `rewind` to the entry mark and `exitFrame` are accepted, and the stack is empty
again. -/
def opsF : List DOp :=
  setup1 ++ [.kernel (.derive 0 0 .modify), .kernel (.enter [6] [lf]), .mark 0, .push 0 2 8]

theorem case_frame :
    (drun K0 DS.init opsF).isSome = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsF) (.rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩)).isReject = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init (opsF ++ [.kernel (.endUse 8), .rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩, .kernel .exit])).isSome = true ∧
    (final (opsF ++ [.kernel (.endUse 8), .rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩, .kernel .exit])).stacks.map
      (fun st => (st.top, st.blocks, st.marks)) = [(0, [], [])] := by
  decide

/-- Block 6 pushed on `[2, 3]`, mark `⟨0, 0, 2⟩`, block grown to `[2, 3, 4]` (authority 7), released;
then 8 derived from `internal` 5 on the cell 2, below the mark. -/
def opsE4 : List DOp :=
  setup1 ++ [.push 0 2 5, .mark 0, .grow 0 6 1, .kernel (.release 7), .kernel (.derive 5 2 .modify)]

/-- Marks `⟨0, 0, 0⟩` and `⟨0, 1, 1⟩` around block 6 on `[2]`; block 7 on `[3]` pushed after both
marks, released, and returned by `rewind ⟨0, 1, 1⟩`; block 6 released; then 9 derived from
`internal` 5 on the cell 3, above the current top. -/
def opsE8 : List DOp :=
  setup1 ++ [.mark 0, .push 0 1 5, .mark 0, .push 0 1 6, .kernel (.release 7),
    .rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 1⟩, .kernel (.release 6), .kernel (.derive 5 3 .modify)]

/-- Mark `⟨0, 0, 0⟩`, then a `push` of size 0: block 6, active, of empty footprint. -/
def opsE3 : List DOp := setup1 ++ [.mark 0, .push 0 0 5]

/-- **Reading of "couvre une région émise après `m`"** (review, DS-2 and DS-3): `rewind` looks at
the cells it returns (`above`). In `opsE4` the authority 8, active and derived from `internal`,
covers the cell 2 of the region `[2, 3, 4]` issued (by `grow`) after the mark `⟨0, 0, 2⟩`, below
the mark, and `rewind` is accepted (the cell 2 is not returned). In `opsE8` the authority 9 covers
the cell 3 of a region issued after `⟨0, 0, 0⟩`, now above the top, and `rewind` is accepted (the
cell 3 is already available). In `opsE3` the empty block 6, issued after the mark and active, does
not block `rewind`, and stays active once the metadata forget it. -/
theorem case_rewind_reading :
    (drun K0 DS.init opsE4).isSome = true ∧
    (final opsE4).s.A[8]?.map (fun y => (y.active, y.origin, y.footprint)) = some (true, some 5, [2]) ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsE4) (.rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 2⟩)).isOk = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init opsE8).isSome = true ∧
    (final opsE8).s.A[9]?.map (fun y => (y.active, y.origin, y.footprint)) = some (true, some 5, [3]) ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsE8) (.rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩)).isOk = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init (opsE3 ++ [.rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩])).isSome = true ∧
    (final (opsE3 ++ [.rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩])).s.A[6]?.map (fun y => (y.active, y.origin, y.footprint)) =
      some (true, some 5, []) ∧
    (final (opsE3 ++ [.rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩])).stacks.map (fun st => (st.top, st.blocks, st.marks)) =
      [(0, [], [])] := by
  decide

/-- Block 6 pushed into 5, then a callee entered with only 7, a `Modify` derived from the root of 5:
it has no right on the stack value 0. -/
def opsZ : List DOp := setup1 ++ [.push 0 1 5, .kernel (.derive 2 5 .modify), .kernel (.enter [7] [])]

/-- Block 6 pushed on `[2]` into the cell 3 of the stack's own storage. -/
def opsIn : List DOp := setup1 ++ [.push 0 1 3]

/-- **Static clauses before `fail`** (§58, §77.4; review, DS-5 and Q2-GROW-ORDER): without a right on
the stack value, `grow` is rejected with or without room; `push` into an `Init` destination is
rejected, with or without room; `push` into a destination inside the requested cells is rejected
even without room, while the same `push` into an outside destination fails; `grow` into a recorded
destination inside the new region is rejected even without room (`opsIn`). -/
theorem case_static_before_fail :
    (drun K0 DS.init opsZ).isSome = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsZ) (.grow 0 6 5)).isReject = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsZ) (.grow 0 6 1)).isReject = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init (setup1 ++ [.kernel (.write 2 [5])])).isSome = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final (setup1 ++ [.kernel (.write 2 [5])])) (.push 0 1 5)).isReject = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final (setup1 ++ [.kernel (.write 2 [5])])) (.push 0 4 5)).isReject = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init setup1).isSome = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final setup1) (.push 0 4 2)).isReject = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final setup1) (.push 0 4 5)).isFail = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init opsIn).isSome = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsIn) (.grow 0 6 1)).isReject = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsIn) (.grow 0 6 5)).isReject = true := by
  decide

/-- The kernel states of the cases are reached. -/
theorem cases_reachable :
    Reachable K0 [] (final opsR).s ∧ Reachable K0 [] (final opsA).s ∧
    Reachable K0 [] (final opsG).s ∧ Reachable K0 [] (final opsS).s ∧
    Reachable K0 [] (final (opsF ++ [.kernel (.endUse 8), .rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩, .kernel .exit])).s :=
  ⟨final_reach (by decide), final_reach (by decide), final_reach (by decide),
    final_reach (by decide), final_reach (by decide)⟩

42	
43	| Théorème | Énoncé |
44	|---|---|
45	| `issue_to_seq` | `IssueR … (ok s' ar')` et `HasRight s' Modify dst` ⟹ `split` puis `store` sont `ok`, avec l'état d'arrivée `s'` |
46	| `seq_to_issue` | `split` puis `store` `ok`, région disponible, destination non `Init` ⟹ `IssueR … (ok s₂ _)`, même état d'arrivée |
47	| `issue_as_kernel_split` | équivalence des deux, pour toute région |
48	| `issue_as_kernel` | même équivalence avec `derive` sur un emplacement `q` (région = empreinte de `q`) |

51	Forme exacte (`issue_as_kernel_split`), pour tout état atteint `s` et toute entrée `ar ∈ s.arenas` :
52	
53	```
54	IssueR ar r dst s (ok s' ar') ∧ HasRight s' Modify dst
55	  ⟺ Avail ar r ∧ (dst non Init) ∧ split(internal, [r]) ok ∧ store(bloc, dst) ok vers s' ∧ ar' = métadonnées de §77
